extracted.intended_audience: researchers (especially early-career), journal editors, and academic publishers
extracted.subtask_description: Describing and evaluating a platform (Publons) that tracks publications, citation metrics, peer reviews, and editorial work and provides training to improve peer-review practices and recognition. Useful for researchers seeking to document and demonstrate peer-review contributions and for publishers seeking peer-review solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive researcher profile
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep track of publications, citation metrics, peer reviews and journal editing work in a single, easy-to-use profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publons centralizes an author's publications, citation metrics, peer reviews and editorial activities so researchers can present a more complete record of their contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ease of tracking and demonstrating impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Make it quick and easy for researchers to track and demonstrate a more complete record of their impact as an author, journal editor, and peer reviewer, in one place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed for efficiency in compiling evidence of impact for performance reviews, funding, and promotion; integrates with Web of Science (since 2018) to simplify tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition for peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Help researchers get recognition for their often hidden peer review contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publons was built to automate recognition by partnering with publishers and providing features that record and display peer-review and editorial work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in peer review processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring greater transparency to peer review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publons partners with academic publishers to provide peer review solutions intended to increase openness about review activity and improve visibility of contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency of peer review processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring greater efficiency to peer review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the platform's stated goals is to speed up scientific development by encouraging collaboration and streamlining aspects of peer review through tools and publisher integrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring greater quality to peer review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publons positions itself as improving the quality of peer review by offering systems and training (via the Publons Academy) that teach core competencies and promote better reviewing practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-review training and core competencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Teach early career researchers the core competencies of peer-reviewing (Publons Academy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Publons Academy is a free peer review training course developed with expert academics and editors to instruct early-career researchers in core reviewing skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher partnership and integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Partner with academic publishers to provide peer review solutions designed to bring transparency, efficiency, quality, and recognition to their peer review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publons works with publishers to automate the capture of review activity and to integrate review-recording features into publisher workflows, enabling institutional adoption and wider visibility.
